On today’s surprisingly affordable edition of Quick Charge , we check out all the new cheap tricks trucks coming for your hard-earned money in 2027, and challenge the seemingly popular idea that low tech automatically begets low costs.
Name for Ransom E. Olds, the guy who founded Oldsmobile in the early part of the last century, cheap truck startup REO is hoping to undercut Jeff Bezos-backed startup Slate by offering a low-tech, low-cost ICE pickup with standard 4WD, a 500,000 usable mile engine life, an open source service solution, and a price that’s nearly $3,000 lower than Slate’s.
If REO can make it happen, it’ll be a seriously impressive accomplishment. That said, I feel like I’ve seen this episode before – and it was called Elio Motors. Give this one a listen and let us know what you think in the comments.
Prefer listening to your podcasts? Audio-only versions of Quick Charge are now available on Apple Podcasts , Spotify , TuneIn , and our RSS feed for Overcast and other podcast players
